name: searchLibraryForced
signature: export function searchLibraryForced(effect: Extract<Effect, { do: 'search-library' }>, ctx: AbilityContext, env: PrimitiveEnv): PrimitiveResult
rules: CR 701.19c a search of a hidden zone still shuffles
contract: A library with no matching card still shuffles when the effect says to: CR 701.19 makes the shuffle part of the effect, not a consequence of finding something.
When the eligible pool is at most count the search has no hidden choice left; emit the MOVE_ZONE actions, then the SHUFFLE, in that order.
Otherwise emit the SHUFFLE if the effect asks for one and defer once. Emitting the shuffle while deferring the choice is correct, and is the case a naive implementation gets wrong.
A tapped flag rides on the MOVE_ZONE when the effect says the card enters tapped.
The shuffle is a SHUFFLE action, never a reordering performed here: the seeded RNG belongs to the reducer.

evidence.claim: the library is shuffled whether or not the search found anything
found cards are moved, not copied

why.textMustContain: Search your library for a basic land card
Search your library for a card

assertions.given: Rampant Growth with one basic land left in the library
assertions.expect: one MOVE_ZONE tapped to battlefield, then SHUFFLE, zero deferred

assertions.given: Rampant Growth with four basics in the library
assertions.expect: SHUFFLE only, plus one deferred naming the search

assertions.given: a library with no basic land at all
assertions.expect: SHUFFLE emitted, zero deferred - CR 701.19 shuffles anyway
